newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia unhappy with Dutch treatment of pilot.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia unhappy with Dutch treatment of pilot.

text.p: Indonesia has criticised the Netherlands for its handling of a pilot from its flag carrier Garuda Indonesia who is accused of smuggling the designer drug Ecstasy, the official Antara news agency said on Tuesday.

"Indonesia, through diplomatic channels, has already called the Dutch government to say it is unhappy with the handling of that case, which is less than humanitarian," Foreign Minister Ali Alatas was quoted as saying by Antara.
Indonesia has accused the Dutch police of ill-treating the pilot while he has been in detention.
The pilot was detained on September 29 at Schipol Airport in Amsterdam while preparing to board a Garuda jet bound for the island of Bali. Police said he had 8,000 Ecstasy pills strapped to his body.
